display.purpose: Home and result declarations set in tightly compressed lines.

title.purpose: Serve calls, pause titles, and compact panel statements.

label.purpose: Uppercase metadata, legends, stamps, and round names.

score.purpose: Tabular scoreboard figures and competitive numbers.

control.purpose: Heavy condensed text for primary, secondary, and text actions.

shadows.name: high-broadcast-lift
shadows.purpose: Score ribbon, serve ticket, and pause panel over the live court.

shadows.name: primary-action-lift
shadows.purpose: Warm low lift under the decisive orange action.

shadows.name: primary-action-hover
shadows.purpose: Slightly deeper action shadow paired with a one-pixel rise.

shadows.name: bracket-card-lift
shadows.purpose: Low separation for entrant cards against tournament navy.

shadows.name: sticky-strip-lift
shadows.purpose: Upward separation for the next-match strip.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Primary action color, lift, and press feedback.

motion.name: choice-standard
motion.purpose: Difficulty border, background, and text state changes.

motion.name: point-call
motion.purpose: Brief point confirmation that rises, holds, and clears.

motion.name: ball-trail-life
motion.purpose: Canvas trail persistence that communicates ball direction and pace.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Effective removal of animation and transition duration for reduced-motion preferences.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The decisive orange action used to enter, serve, play, resume, or advance.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { min-height: 46px; padding: 12px 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: #241006; background: var(--orange, #ff5a36); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(91, 22, 10, 0.28); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-stretch: condensed; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, transform 140ms ease-out, box-shadow 140ms ease-out; } .ds-primary-action:hover { background: #ff7658; box-shadow: 0 13px 30px rgba(91, 22, 10, 0.34); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-primary-action:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow, #ffcb54); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Selected Difficulty
components.description: A locked-in competition tier with explicit pressed state and supporting copy.
components.css: .ds-difficulty { display: grid; gap: 3px; min-width: 150px; min-height: 62px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--orange, #ff5a36); border-radius: 4px; color: #fff6ef; background: #8e2f20; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms ease-out, background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-difficulty strong { font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-stretch: condensed; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 800; } .ds-difficulty span { font: 400 0.66rem/1.25 'Public Sans Variable', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; } .ds-difficulty:hover { border-color: #ff7658; } .ds-difficulty:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow, #ffcb54); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Score Ribbon
components.description: The three-part match scoreboard with service state, round, and win condition.
components.css: .ds-score-ribbon { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; width: min(620px, 100%); min-height: 52px; border: 1px solid #49636a; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--ink, #09202b); background: var(--bone, #f5eddb); box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(2, 13, 18, 0.34); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-score-side { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 6px 12px; } .ds-score-side span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-stretch: condensed; font-weight: 850; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-score-side i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--orange, #ff5a36); } .ds-score-side i.ds-opponent { background: #82bd57; } .ds-score-side strong { font-size: 2rem; font-stretch: condensed; font-weight: 900; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1; } .ds-score-side.ds-is-serving::after { position: absolute; bottom: -5px; left: 50%; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--orange, #ff5a36); content: ''; transform: translateX(-50%); } .ds-score-center { display: grid; min-width: 140px; place-content: center; border-right: 1px solid #bbb5a9; border-left: 1px solid #bbb5a9; text-align: center; } .ds-score-center span, .ds-score-center b { display: block; font-size: 0.6rem; line-height: 1.25; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-score-center span { font-weight: 780; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-score-center b { color: #42565b; font-weight: 650; }

components.name: Bracket Match
components.description: A dense two-entrant tournament card with visible current-match and winner states.
components.css: .ds-bracket-match { min-width: 240px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #32515d; border-radius: 4px; color: #b9ccce; background: #0b2a37; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(2, 13, 18, 0.2); font-family: 'Public Sans Variable', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; } .ds-bracket-match.ds-current { border-color: var(--orange, #ff5a36); } .ds-bracket-match span { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 9px; align-items: center; min-height: 33px; padding: 7px 9px; font-size: 0.78rem; } .ds-bracket-match span + span { border-top: 1px solid #284652; } .ds-bracket-match span.ds-winner { color: #fff9ed; background: #144052; } .ds-bracket-match i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--mark); } .ds-bracket-match b { overflow: hidden; font-weight: 650; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-bracket-match em { color: #7f9ba1; font-size: 0.68rem; font-style: normal; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Serve Ticket
components.description: A centered bone officiating overlay shown once at the opening of each match; later rallies restart automatically.
components.html: CLUB · SMASHCAR SERVESDrag the paddle. Swipe through contact for pace and spin.
components.css: .ds-serve-ticket { display: grid; width: min(360px, calc(100% - 40px)); justify-items: center; padding: 22px 26px; border: 1px solid #79766e; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--ink, #09202b); background: var(--bone, #f5eddb); box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(2, 13, 18, 0.34); text-align: center; font-family: 'Public Sans Variable', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; } .ds-serve-ticket > span { color: #496067; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 760; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-serve-ticket > strong { margin: 5px 0 14px; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 1.75rem; font-stretch: condensed; font-weight: 860; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-serve-ticket button { min-height: 46px; padding: 12px 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: #241006; background: var(--orange, #ff5a36); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-stretch: condensed; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, transform 140ms ease-out; } .ds-serve-ticket button:hover { background: #ff7658; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-serve-ticket button:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-serve-ticket button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow, #ffcb54); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-serve-ticket small { max-width: 32ch; margin-top: 12px; color: #526469; font-size: 0.68rem; line-height: 1.35; }

components.name: Match Tool
components.description: A compact text-first utility control for sound and pause.
components.css: .ds-match-tool { min-width: 50px; height: 44px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid #82999e; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--bone, #f5eddb); background: #0b2a37; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.63rem; font-stretch: condensed; font-weight: 820; letter-spacing: 0.06em; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms ease-out, background-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-match-tool:hover { border-color: var(--bone, #f5eddb); background: var(--navy-raised, #0d2b38); } .ds-match-tool:active { background: #061722; } .ds-match-tool:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow, #ffcb54); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Cup Badge
components.description: The circular Eleven Cup tournament seal used beside the draw heading.
components.css: .ds-cup-badge { display: grid; width: 74px; height: 74px; place-content: center; border: 4px solid var(--bone, #f5eddb); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--ink, #09202b); background: var(--yellow, #ffcb54); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--yellow, #ffcb54); text-align: center; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-stretch: condensed; font-weight: 900; line-height: 0.9; } .ds-cup-badge span { display: block; font-size: 2rem; } .ds-cup-badge small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 0.58rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; }

components.name: Brand Lockup
components.description: The condensed Rally Eleven home mark with its orange double slash.
components.css: .ds-brand-lockup { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.12em; align-items: baseline; color: var(--bone, #f5eddb); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 1.65rem; font-stretch: condensed; font-weight: 850; letter-spacing: -0.035em; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand-lockup i { color: var(--orange, #ff5a36); font-style: normal; font-weight: 900; } .ds-brand-lockup:hover { color: #fff9ed; } .ds-brand-lockup:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow, #ffcb54); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The Compact Championship turns every viewport into a small, credible tournament venue. The game borrows the clarity and hierarchy of televised sport—score ribbon, seeded draw, court lines, officiating labels—without pretending to be a simulation or imitating a licensed broadcast package.

The rally is the visual hero. In play, the Canvas 2D court fills the screen from the player’s eye line, the near paddle owns the lower third, and interface chrome compresses into a taut band at the top. Away from the rally, the same navy, bone, orange, and ruled geometry make difficulty selection, bracket progression, and results feel like parts of one championship.

The system is athletic, direct, and deliberately compact: condensed Archivo delivers the calls, Public Sans carries explanation, warm court materials keep the dark arena human, and small high-contrast signals make current state unmistakable. All shipped visuals are CSS or Canvas 2D; texture, atmosphere, and depth come from geometry, tonal layering, and restrained shadow rather than raster decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed, player-eye court composition with the paddle, ball, and contact trail as the signature interaction.
Deep tournament navy and bone broadcast surfaces grounded by a sea-green table and warm beech floor.
Condensed athletic display type paired with a plain, highly legible interface sans.
Taut rectangular panels, fine rules, circular seals, and small enamel-like competitor marks.
Signal orange for player agency and decisive state; rally yellow for ball, focus, scores, and brief feedback.
Mobile-first safe-area handling, short-landscape compression, and portrait fallbacks that preserve the competition structure.

rules.name: The Orange Earns the Whistle Rule
rules.body: Signal orange belongs to player agency or a decisive state; do not use it as general decoration or a large background field.

rules.name: The Bone Carries the Score Rule
rules.body: Bone surfaces are reserved for high-salience broadcast information over the dark arena, especially scoring and interruption overlays.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Archivo calls the match—identity, headlines, controls, labels, and scores—while Public Sans explains it. Do not add a third typographic personality.

rules.name: The Rally Owns Landscape Rule
rules.body: Compress chrome before court space; the ball, table, and controllable paddle must remain immediately readable on a short phone viewport.

rules.name: The Lift Only What Interrupts Rule
rules.body: Strong elevation belongs to score, serve, pause, and decisive action layers; ordinary tournament structure stays close to the navy field.

rules.name: The Squared Broadcast Rule
rules.body: Keep structural UI within the badge-to-overlay radius range; reserve full circles for sport objects, status marks, and the cup seal.

dos: Do keep the court or tournament structure visible from the first viewport; this is a championship experience, not a menu-first shell.
Do preserve the full-bleed player-eye court, top score ribbon, and lower-third paddle hierarchy in match play.
Do use orange for player agency and decisive state, yellow for focus and momentary rally feedback, and explicit text or position alongside both.
Do keep touch targets legible, honor safe-area insets, and retain the short-landscape and portrait adaptations.
Do build atmosphere with CSS and Canvas 2D geometry, tonal layers, fine rules, and restrained shadow.
donts: Don't replace the court-led composition with a stack of floating rounded cards or a generic casual-game dashboard.
Don't introduce a third font, soft lifestyle typography, or wide airy display spacing that weakens the athletic cadence.
Don't spread signal colors across decorative backgrounds; their scarcity is what makes match state immediate.
Don't round structural panels into pills; full circles belong to sport objects, state marks, and the cup seal.
Don't add raster textures, stock sports imagery, or licensed broadcast motifs to a visual world built from original geometry.
